name: Intracellular Ca2+-release channels (ITPR + RYR)
description: The two families the parent project (`../ip3r_genes`) censused in full, run here as the cross-check: the same search through this project's catalogue and classifier should reproduce its ITPR/RYR separation. The four diagnostic Pfam domains are shared between the two families, so a run that does not carry the RYR panel loses the D14 test entirely — which is why `scope: ca_release` includes both.
